Predict species from audio files using a BirdNET acoustic model

Source: R/predict.R
birdnet_predict.birdnet_model_acoustic.Rd

Identifies species in audio files with an acoustic model (BirdNET+ V3.0, BirdNET V2.4, Perch v2 or a custom classifier).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'birdnet_model_acoustic'
birdnet_predict(
  model,
  files,
  min_confidence = 0.1,
  min_confidence_custom = NULL,
  top_k = 5L,
  overlap = 0,
  apply_sigmoid = NULL,
  sigmoid_sensitivity = NULL,
  bandpass_fmin = 0L,
  bandpass_fmax = 15000L,
  species_list = NULL,
  progress = c("minimal", "progress", "benchmark"),
  n_producers = NULL,
  n_workers = NULL,
  batch_size = NULL,
  prefetch_ratio = NULL,
  speed = NULL,
  half_precision = NULL,
  max_audio_duration_min = NULL,
  apply_softmax = NULL,
  segment_size_s = NULL,
  device = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

model

A BirdNET model object of class birdnet_model_acoustic, see birdnet_load(), birdnet_load_perch() and birdnet_load_custom().

files

A character vector of one or more file paths to audio files. The resulting data frame (via as.data.frame()) has an input column that names the source file of each row.

min_confidence

A numeric value to set the minimum confidence threshold for predictions.

min_confidence_custom

A named list where each element is a single numeric value to set custom minimum confidence thresholds for specific species. A custom threshold will override the default one.

top_k

An integer specifying the number of top predictions to return for each segment if above minimum confidence threshold. NULL returns every species above the threshold.

overlap

A numeric value specifying the overlap duration in seconds between consecutive segments. Must be smaller than the segment length (3 s for BirdNET V2.4; see segment_size_s for V3.0).

apply_sigmoid

A logical value indicating whether to apply a sigmoid function to the confidence scores. If NULL (default), the model's own default is used.

sigmoid_sensitivity

A numeric value that shifts the sigmoid scores, see Details. Must be in the interval [0.5, 1.5]. If NULL (default), the model's own default (1.0) is used.

bandpass_fmin, bandpass_fmax

An integer value to set minimum and maximum frequencies for the bandpass filter (in Hz).

species_list

A character vector or list of species names to filter the predictions. If NULL, all species are considered.

progress

A character string specifying the type of progress reporting. Options are "minimal", "progress", or "benchmark".

n_producers

An integer specifying the number of processes that read and prepare audio batches. Must be >= 1. If NULL (default), the default of the birdnet Python package is used.

n_workers

An integer specifying the number of worker processes for parallel inference. Each worker loads its own copy of the model. If NULL (default), birdnet chooses based on available CPU cores and memory; with a GPU device, one worker per device.

batch_size

An integer specifying the number of audio segments evaluated per inference call. Must be >= 1. The BirdNET+ V3.0 "pb" and "tf" models only accept 1; use n_workers for parallelism there. If NULL (default), the default of the birdnet Python package (1) is used.

prefetch_ratio

An integer specifying how many batches to decode ahead of processing. Must be >= 0. If NULL (default), the default of the birdnet Python package is used.

speed

A numeric value for the resampling multiplier to accommodate different recording speeds. Must be in the interval [0.01, 100]. If NULL (default), the default of the birdnet Python package is used.

half_precision

A logical value indicating whether to store the model's outputs as float16 (inference itself runs at the model's precision). If NULL (default), the default of the birdnet Python package is used.

max_audio_duration_min

A numeric value specifying the longest single input in minutes. Must be > 0. If NULL (default), no limit is applied.

apply_softmax

A logical value. If TRUE, scores become a softmax over the model's logits (e.g. for Perch v2). Not supported by models that apply the sigmoid inside the model (BirdNET+ V3.0, Raven exports). If NULL (default), the model's own default (FALSE) is used.

segment_size_s

A numeric value: length of the analyzed segments in seconds (BirdNET+ V3.0 only; it accepts variable-length input). If NULL (default), the model's own default is used.

device

A character string, "CPU" or "GPU" (or a vector of devices). If NULL (default), the CPU is used. See birdnet_use_gpu().

...

Not used. Passing any other argument is an error.

Value

An S3 object of class birdnet_prediction_acoustic and birdnet_prediction containing the prediction results.

Details

Confidence scores

With apply_sigmoid = NULL (default) each model uses its own default: BirdNET models and custom classifiers return sigmoid scores between 0 and 1, Perch v2 returns raw model outputs (logits). A score reflects how certain the model is. It is not the probability that the species is present.

sigmoid_sensitivity shifts the scores: values above 1 raise them, values below 1 lower them (the logits are shifted by 10 * (sigmoid_sensitivity - 1) before the sigmoid). It has no effect with apply_sigmoid = FALSE.

For guidelines on BirdNET scores and on converting them to probabilities, see Wood & Kahl (2024).

References

Wood, C. M., & Kahl, S. (2024). Guidelines for appropriate use of BirdNET scores and other detector outputs. Journal of Ornithology. https://doi.org/10.1007/s10336-024-02144-5

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Load a BirdNET acoustic model
model <- birdnet_load()
# Predict species from audio files
audio_file <- system.file("extdata", "soundscape.mp3", package = "birdnetR")
predictions <- birdnet_predict(model, files = audio_file)
# convert predictions to a data frame
as.data.frame(predictions)
} # }
